text.tspan: Brick masonry- in 1:6 cement mortar, 25 cm thick, using high-quality red bricks, including cost and conveyance of all materials to site, labour charges for mixing, laying, curing, scaffolding, and all other incidental charges, complete.
Painting of walls including two coats of wall putty, two coats of primer, and two coats of paint, complete in all respects.
Bed Frame - King sized (LW-1830x2030mm) Custom wooden design with Headboard, complete with materials, finish, and labour.
Bedside Table - (LWH-750x500x550mm) Custom wooden design with 2 Drawers, complete with materials, finish, and labour.
